recommendation.one_line: Restore the MacBook collector from its own branch into a folder that tidy-ups do not touch, install its one dependency, and re-point the launchd job at it. Headless, its own profile, this MacBook only — never the iMac, never Alan's screen.
steps_for_the_coordinator: 1. Give the program a kept home outside _worktrees/: `git -C "/Users/alanharvey/SCINTILLA 0.5/_VERCEL_DEPLOY" worktree add "/Users/alanharvey/SCINTILLA-PROVIDERS/scintilla-xfeed-program" hub/xfeed-program-20260922` then `npm ci` inside it (installs @vercel/blob 2.8.0).
2. `node scripts/xfeed-program.mjs status` — reads the health file, starts nothing.

3. Change the two paths in the plist (ProgramArguments[1] and WorkingDirectory) to the new folder; `launchctl bootout` then `bootstrap` the job. Everything else in the plist stays (--headless, the profile, the runtime folder, the nine times).
4. One supervised pass: `node scripts/xfeed-program.mjs run --headless --catch-up --max-pages 20`. If it answers 'sign-in needed', stop and book the one visible sign-in with Alan.
5. Confirm on the live side: /api/xfeed newest post is today; two hours later x_post_sentiment has rows newer than 25 Sep.

sentiment-x-2h reads only the last 3 days of the feed (?days=3): after an 8-day gap the first run must be called once with days=10 or the caught-up posts are never scored
the X-feed heartbeat row is LATE since 25 Sep and its alarm is off (Q2b STAGED A) — without the alarm the next death is again silent
the catch-up reaches only as far back as X's list timeline serves; posts between 27 Sep and the restore may be partly unrecoverable
recommendation.pattern_followed: A scheduled program lives in a fixed install path owned by its service definition, with its dependencies installed from a lock file at deploy time — the launchd.plist(5) ProgramArguments / WorkingDirectory contract and `npm ci` (https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/commands/npm-ci).
